analysis_scope.mode: repository static analysis refreshed for v3.0.0-rc1
validation_performed: focused and full repository tests tracked separately
validation_limitations: No live FL Studio state is represented.
No automatic FL Studio render, open, save, or project mutation is exercised.

project.name: fls-pilot
project.description: Create more. Check less. Local FL Studio Control Center and MCP workflow assistant for safe mix reviews, routing audits, project cleanup, low-end checks, export readiness, and rollback-first assisted edits.

nodes.label: MCP/AI Clients
nodes.responsibility: User-facing AI host calls MCP tools/resources/prompts.

nodes.label: FastMCP Server
nodes.responsibility: Registers tool modules, resources and prompts; exposes stdio or SSE MCP transports.

nodes.label: MCP Tool Surface
nodes.responsibility: Domain tools for transport, mixer, channel, pattern, playlist, effects, plugins, routing, mix review, project health, KB, audio, MIDI export.

nodes.label: Operation Registry
nodes.responsibility: Declarative safety classes, validation, command mapping, snapshots/readback/restore builders.

nodes.label: Safety & Rollback Layer
nodes.responsibility: Persistent-write contract: scoped snapshot, dry-run, readback verification, changelog, rollback units.

nodes.label: Bridge Client
nodes.responsibility: MIDI SysEx or TCP bridge, request correlation, heartbeat tracking, pagination/retry.

nodes.label: TCP Daemon + Runtime Host
nodes.responsibility: Long-lived local RPC service with canonical Runtime state, durable jobs, audio worker execution, snapshots, reports, and workflow execution.

nodes.label: Control Center
nodes.responsibility: Local HTTP UI for setup, Runtime workflows, durable audio jobs, reports, and evidence linking.

nodes.label: Analysis Runtime
nodes.responsibility: Canonical strict AnalysisReport v1, observations, rendered-audio evidence, freshness, scoring, health aggregation, and workflow declarations.

nodes.label: Knowledgebase
nodes.responsibility: Calibration, FL API limits, safety policies, recipes, templates and workflow guidance.

nodes.label: Music Logic
nodes.responsibility: Scale/raga, plugin/preset libraries, mix doctor rules, MIDI generation, level/curve helpers.

nodes.label: Piano Roll .pyscript Bridge
nodes.responsibility: Generates/triggers FL Piano Roll scripts for note-writing operations where controller API is insufficient.

nodes.label: Virtual MIDI Loopback
nodes.responsibility: Bidirectional MIDI device layer carrying private-use SysEx payloads.

nodes.label: FLStudioPilot Controller Script
nodes.responsibility: Always-on FL controller script; decodes SysEx commands, calls FL Studio API modules, sends responses and heartbeat.

nodes.label: FL Studio API
nodes.responsibility: Host DAW scripting APIs. Sandbox limitations define supported capabilities.

nodes.label: Runtime Audio Analysis Worker
nodes.responsibility: Runs deterministic cancellable offline feature extraction through daemon-owned durable Runtime jobs.

nodes.label: Audio Artifact Store
nodes.responsibility: Atomically publishes versioned feature artifacts and bounded result references.

nodes.label: User-Provided Audio Files
nodes.responsibility: Read-only source material supplied by the user; never moved, modified, deleted, or rendered automatically from FL Studio.

edges.label: FL MIDI engine routes by port

communication_protocol.why: FL controller scripts are sandboxed; always-on controller script cannot use files/network/subprocess, so virtual MIDI is the trusted boundary.

ports.routing: both FL MIDI devices must share the same FL port number, docs use 42

communication_protocol.safe_payload_strategy: host rejects requests and controller replaces responses above 1000 final wire bytes; expensive step, peak, plugin, and list operations use bounded pages or grouped writes

quality_observations: Strong separation between MCP tool surface, protocol bridge, safety contract, runtime analysis, and FL controller script.
Operation registry makes persistent writes declarative and auditable with restore builders.
Runtime protocol rejects raw command/code/script fields for daemon RPC.
Knowledgebase and policy files reduce guessed DAW/plugin ranges.
Controller script is large and central; consider splitting if FL sandbox packaging allows it, or generate a command inventory test from protocol.py to avoid handler drift.
